Manipulate this request's headers with the given consumer. The headers provided to the consumer are "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing header values, remove values, or use any of the other HttpHeaders methods.

items.source: Manipulate this request's cookies with the given consumer. The map provided to the consumer is "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing cookie values, remove cookies, or use any of the other MultiValueMap methods.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操作这些 Cookie。提供给 Consumer 的 Map 是“活的”，因此该 Consumer 可用于 覆盖现有的 Cookie 值、移除Cookies，或使用任何其他 MultiValueMap 方法。

items.source: Callback for access to the ClientHttpRequest that in turn provides access to the native request of the underlying HTTP library.
items.translation: 用于访问 `ClientHttpRequest` 的回调，该接口进而提供对底层 HTTP 库的原生请求的访问。

items.source: Callback for access to the ClientHttpRequest that in turn provides access to the native request of the underlying HTTP library. This could be useful for setting advanced, per-request options that exposed by the underlying library.
items.translation: 用于访问 `ClientHttpRequest` 的回调，该接口进而提供对底层 HTTP 库的原生请求的访问。这对于设置由底层库暴露的高级、每请求选项可能很有用。
